question: Which one of the following was the last imperial dynasty to rule China?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Qing dynasty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Qing dynasty ruled from **1644 to 1912.**
 
• It was the last dynasty in the history of China.
 
• The dynasty succeeded the Ming dynasty.
 
• The dynasty was** established in 1636**.
 
• Emperor Shunzhi founded the Qing Dynasty.

 Xuantong was the last emperor of the dynasty.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Yuan dynasty **ruled from **1279–1368.**

 
 
• **Shizu **was the** founder of the dynasty.**
 
• **Shundi **was the last emperor of the dynasty.
 
 
 
• **Sui dynasty **ruled from **581–618.**
 
 
• **Wendi **was the **founder of the dynasty.**
 
• **Gongdi **was the** last ruler.**
 
 
 
• **Ming dynasty** ruled from** 1368–1644**.
 
 
• **Taizu **was the** founder of the dynasty.**
 
• **Ssuzong **was the** last ruler.**
